connectionString.label: MongoDB connection string
connectionString.help: Paste the complete MongoDB URI. Atlas example: mongodb+srv://<username>:<password>@iobroker-data.s8yl5.mongodb.net/iobroker. Encode reserved URI characters in usernames and passwords.

collection.label: Raw history collection
collection.help: Use a regular collection here. For a time-series output, configure the existing time-series collection under Mapped output collection and enable an aggregation pipeline.

aggregationPipeline.label: MongoDB aggregation JSON
aggregationPipeline.help: Requires MongoDB 6.0+. Enter a pipeline as a JSON array; the adapter supplies the input document through $documents. Input fields: _id, id, ts, val, ack, q, from. The datapoint Alias ID replaces id here; use $id for the alias. Keep _id in the output. For a time-series target, output its configured timeField as a BSON Date (for example with $toDate). Transformed events are inserted directly into the output collection; they are not stored in the raw history collection. If the configured pipeline cannot run, the adapter skips the write rather than storing raw data. Write stages and server-side code operators are blocked.

aggregationCollection.label: Mapped output collection
aggregationCollection.help: Transformed documents are inserted here. With a pipeline enabled, new events are not also written to the raw history collection and are therefore unavailable through getHistory.
